chapters.title: Chapter 1: Seven, three, one, nine

fragments.text: The Voice's numbers aren't random: 7-3-1-9 repeats every hour on the hour, like a timetable.
A station calling itself Echo-7 answers on the medium band. It says its name and cuts out.

fragments.source: Police station archive or Irene's lab
fragments.text: A folder: "Project Echo. Early warning network. Activation: 03:10". The hour the Silence began.
At the northern antenna there's equipment installed after the Silence. Plate: ECHO-7. It relays something from farther away.
For the first time, the Voice asks something: "Who else is listening?"

finale: Bunker operator. Seven, three, one, nine. We know you're listening.
The Silence didn't end. It just got quieter.
When you're ready, find the Echo-7 station. End of transmission.
chapters.closing: Chapter 1 complete. The Voice knows you exist.
